scope:
Isolated mGBA Nuzlocke fixtures, not a complete adventure playthrough.
New-game mode selection and Continue use controller input. Parties, maps, status,
encounter policies and PC rosters are prepared via native calls. Flash writes and
final erasure affect only this emulator's temporary battery, never a user save.
cases: New game selects Nuzlocke through the native menu
First encounter stays eligible for multiple Ball attempts
Leaving the first encounter without a catch consumes the zone
Owned starter is skipped as a duplicate; the first new species is eligible
Previously obtained species blocked in another zone, including after release
Shiny duplicate can be caught even in a consumed zone
Shiny encounter does not consume the ordinary encounter
Encounter limits begin with the first Ball supply, not the parcel trip
Balls cost 20 percent less; Potion price unchanged
Permanent death: healing, Revive, Max Revive and PC reconstruction cannot revive; dead slot removed
Field poison death is permanent too
A survivor in the last PC slot rescues the run
Native battery Continue preserves mode and the lost first encounter
Total loss erases all flash sectors, including both alternating save slots
After Game Over, reset has no valid Continue save
